description: Update an existing course and return the updated Canvas course object. Only the fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are left as-is, and calling it again with the same values leaves the course in the same state (idempotent). Requires permission to update course details; a caller who has only that lesser permission (not full course update rights) can still change syllabus_body through this same call, but every other field they pass is silently dropped rather than erroring. Use create_course for a new course, or get_course to see the current values before changing them.

apply_assignment_group_weights.description: Whether the final grade is weighted by assignment group percentages

course_id.description: The Canvas course ID to update

end_at.description: New end date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-05-15T00:00:00Z)

hide_final_grades.description: Whether to hide the totals in the student grades summary

start_at.description: New start date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-01-15T00:00:00Z)

syllabus_body.description: HTML body for the course syllabus

name: update_course
title: Update Course
